features.name: Cluster refills
features.description: Five or more adjacent symbols win, then the reels refill.

features.name: 2x2 big symbols

features.name: Big Boss split
features.description: The Big Boss splits into four symbols during a refill.

review:
A crime-themed cluster game with a match-3 feel. Five or more matching symbols touching up, down or sideways make a cluster, and the reels refill.

The twist: four identical symbols in a square merge into one 2x2 big symbol that doubles any cluster it's part of – and several big symbols in one win add their multipliers together. A Big Boss symbol can split into four regular ones mid-refill. Very high volatility, 12,000x max, 96.3% RTP, free spins about once every 380 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 380 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
